layouts.description: Authoritative 16 MiB ESP32-S3 partition layouts for the Waveshare AMOLED boards. esp32/tools/partition_layouts.py validates this file, the PlatformIO CSVs, built partition tables and the signed USB recovery/migration recipes against it. The website consumes a byte-identical copy as a test fixture. Never edit a published layout; add a new id instead.

notice: Public test key only; never a production trust anchor.
